notes:
REF-BM-02: Metadata collection handles title and description but not favicon or preview image.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, description, and tags are editable, but notes are unsupported.
REF-BM-07: Cards expose title, description, and tags but display a generated letter badge instead of a favicon.
REF-BM-12: Case-insensitive substring search covers title, description, and URL, but there is no note field to search.
REF-BM-14: Search does not parse #tag syntax.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised search expressions are not parsed.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases are treated as literal text including the quote characters, not exact-phrase syntax.
REF-BM-17: No unread/read-later state or action exists.
REF-BM-18: No separate unread view exists.
REF-BM-19: Bookmarks cannot be marked read.
REF-BM-20: No multi-selection or bulk actions exist.
REF-BM-21: No whole-filtered-collection bulk action exists.
REF-BM-22: Results are fixed to newest-first date ordering with no selectable sort key.
REF-BM-23: Bookmark notes and markdown rendering are absent.
REF-BM-24: Local HTML/PDF snapshots are absent.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is absent.
REF-BM-26: Bookmark archiving is absent.
REF-BM-27: Permanent deletion is implemented, but there is no reversible archive operation to distinguish from it.
REF-BM-28: No archived-bookmarks list exists.
REF-BM-29: Saved filter bundles are absent.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is absent.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is absent.
REF-BM-32: Display-related personal settings are absent.
